text.aria-label: Title text 'Net power and three day-ahead forecasts in a summer and a winter week'

g.text: Net power and three day-ahead forecasts in a summer and a winter week

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly net power as a percentage of each substation's effective capacity (negative is export). Lines are the median of each day-ahead forecast. Black: measured. Orange: A1, the model with drift (frozen at 1 July 2025). Blue: A3, A1 plus the Kalman filter on recent residuals. Purple: W, the best history window.'
text.tspan: Half-hourly net power as a percentage of each substation's effective capacity (negative is
export). Lines are the median of each day-ahead forecast. Black: measured. Orange: A1, the
model with drift (frozen at 1 July 2025). Blue: A3, A1 plus the Kalman filter on recent
residuals. Purple: W, the best history window.
